checks.atomic_failure: x=Inventory({'a':3,'b':0});assert x.reserve('r',[('a',2),('b',1)]) is False;assert x.snapshot()=={'a':3,'b':0};assert x.reserve('r',[('a',1)]) is True
checks.duplicate_skus: x=Inventory({'a':5});assert x.reserve('r',[('a',2),('a',2)]) is True;assert x.snapshot()=={'a':1};assert x.cancel('r') is True;assert x.snapshot()=={'a':5}
checks.replay_identity: x=Inventory({'a':9,'b':2});assert x.reserve('r',[('a',1),('a',2),('b',1)]);assert x.reserve('r',[('b',1),('a',3)]);assert x.snapshot()=={'a':6,'b':1};assert x.reserve('r',[('a',1)]) is False
checks.cancel_once_reuse: x=Inventory({'a':3});assert x.reserve('r',[('a',1)]);assert x.cancel('r');assert x.cancel('r') is False;assert x.snapshot()=={'a':3};assert x.reserve('r',[('a',2)]);assert x.snapshot()=={'a':1}
checks.invalid_input: x=Inventory({'a':3});assert x.reserve('r',[('z',1)]) is False;assert x.reserve('r',[('a',0)]) is False;assert x.reserve('r',[('a',-1)]) is False;assert x.snapshot()=={'a':3};assert x.reserve('r',[]) is True;assert x.cancel('r') is True
